Minimum characteristics: RP2350 (needs PIO + second QSPI CS); >=2MB PSRAM; 2.4GHz WiFi; Pico-compatible 40-pin castellation layout with GP0-GP17 in Pico positions
Acceptable alternatives: Any RP2350 board with onboard PSRAM AND wireless in the Pico form factor
Do not substitute with: Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W (no PSRAM); Pimoroni Pico Plus 2 non-W (no radio); any RP2040 board (no PSRAM support, no second QSPI CS)
Notes: Pimoroni PIM726. Ships without headers. Firmware sets PICO_BOARD=pimoroni_pico_plus2_w_rp2350.

Minimum characteristics: Vcc 3.3V operation; inputs tolerant to 5.5V with Vcc=3.3V; propagation delay <=10 ns; output drive >=8 mA; 20-pin wide-body SOIC
Do not substitute with: 74HC541 / 74HCT541 / 74AHC541 (inputs NOT 5V tolerant at 3.3V Vcc - will be damaged); TSSOP or narrow SOIC-20 versions (wrong footprint)
Notes: The 5V tolerance is the whole reason this part exists in the design. Check the datasheet input clamp spec before substituting.

Minimum characteristics: Vds >=20V; Vgs(th) max <=2.0V (must fully enhance from a 3.3V gate); Rds(on) <=10 ohm at Vgs=3.3V; Id >=100 mA; Ciss <=100 pF; SOT-23 pinout G/S/D
Acceptable alternatives: BSS138LT1G; 2N7002E; DMN2075U; any logic-level SOT-23 N-FET meeting the above
Do not substitute with: Standard 2N7002 (Vgs(th) up to 2.5V - marginal or non-conducting from a 3.3V gate); any FET specified only at Vgs=10V
Notes: Open-drain drivers; gate drive is inverting (GPIO high = bus asserted low). Q5 carries RDATA at a 2 us bitcell so keep Ciss low; the rising edge is set by the host's pull-up and cable capacitance.

Minimum characteristics: Schottky only; Vr >=20V; If >=0.5A; Vf <=0.55V at 500 mA; SMA footprint
Acceptable alternatives: SS12; SS13; B140; MBRS140; 1N5819 in SMA
Do not substitute with: Any standard silicon rectifier (1N4001/1N4148 etc) - the ~0.7-1.0V drop sags VSYS
Notes: Isolates the 5V feed so the board can be powered from the floppy connector and USB simultaneously. Low Vf matters more than current rating; the module draws well under 500 mA.

Minimum characteristics: X7R or X5R dielectric; >=16V (50V preferred); tolerance +/-10% or +/-20% - not critical
Acceptable alternatives: Any X7R 0603 16V-50V; 0402 or 0805 will also bridge the pads with care
Do not substitute with: Y5V or Z5U dielectric (capacitance collapses over temperature, up to -80%)

Minimum characteristics: X5R or X7R dielectric; >=16V rating (25V preferred); tolerance +/-20% is normal
Acceptable alternatives: Any X5R/X7R 0805 16V-25V; tantalum or electrolytic >=10uF also acceptable here
Do not substitute with: 6.3V-rated MLCC (DC bias derating loses over half the capacitance at 5V); Y5V/Z5U dielectric
Notes: Voltage rating matters far more than tolerance because of DC bias derating.

Package: 2.54 mm pitch THT male dual row
Minimum characteristics: 2.54 mm pitch both axes; 0.64 mm square posts; mating length >=6 mm; current >=1A per contact; unshrouded
Acceptable alternatives: Any 2x17 2.54 mm male header; a 2x20 header cut down to 17 positions
Do not substitute with: Shrouded/boxed IDC header - its 10.16 mm body overhangs the Q1-Q6 pads by 1.35 mm and will not fit rev A
Notes: Mates with a standard 34-way ribbon with female IDC sockets. Pin 1 is a square pad and marked on silkscreen.

Package: 2.54 mm pitch THT male single row
Minimum characteristics: 2.54 mm pitch; 0.64 mm square posts; current >=2A per contact for the 5V pin
Acceptable alternatives: Any 1x4 2.54 mm male header; or solder wires directly to the pads
Do not substitute with: Connectors on 2.0 mm or 0.1 in-incompatible pitch
Notes: Pin 1 = +5V, pins 2/3 = GND, pin 4 = +12V (routed to the header only, unused by the board).

Package: 2.54 mm pitch THT male SINGLE row
Minimum characteristics: 2.54 mm pitch; 20 positions; 0.64 mm square posts; body height to suit your standoff
Acceptable alternatives: Two 1x20 single-row headers, or a 1x40 strip snapped into two 20-way pieces
Do not substitute with: A 2x20 DUAL-ROW header - the Pico's two rows are 17.78 mm apart, not 2.54 mm
Notes: Two separate single rows. Pimoroni boards ship bare.

Minimum characteristics: 2 layers; 1.6 mm; 1 oz outer copper; min track 0.30 mm; min drill 0.35 mm; tented vias
Acceptable alternatives: HASL or ENIG finish both fine
